title: Queuing Bulk Moves by Root Folder
body:
### Is there an existing issue for this?

- [x] I have searched the existing open and closed issues

### Current Behavior

When you queue a bulk root folder move and select to have Sonarr move the files then queue another bulk move in the same way but to a different root folder, it completes the 2 bulk tasks but then moves everything from job 1 to the root folder in job 2. 
Job 1: Move 10 items from /media1 to /mediaA
Job 2: Move 10 items from /media2 to /mediaB
Job 1 completes 10 items are now in /mediaA
Job 2 completes 10 items are now in /mediaB
Some unknown job now runs and moves 10 items from /mediaA to /mediaB

### Expected Behavior

Jobs should stop after successful completion of bulk move.

### Steps To Reproduce

1. Select multiple series
2. Edit
3. Change root folder
4. Apply Changes
5. Yes, Move the Files
6. Select a different set of multiple series
7. Edit
8. Change root folder to a different destination
9. Apply Changes
10. Yes, Move the Files

Everything will end up int he 2nd destination

### Environment

```markdown
- OS: Ubuntu 24.04.4 LTS
- Sonarr: 4.0.19.2979
- Docker Install: Yes
- Using Reverse Proxy: Yes
- Browser: Brave 1.92.139 (Official Build) (64-bit) / Chromium: 150.0.7871.114
- Database: Sqlite 3.51.2
```

### What branch are you running?

Main

### Trace Logs?

I don't have trace logs.

### Anything else?

_No response_
